A huge slab has been opened before you. The pictures around 
you show the barrel creatures fleeing great turmoil: enormous 
slabs of ice seem to be flying from the sky. Some of the barrel 
creatures seem to have frozen where they stand. Intuitively you 
believe the answer is here. Go to 580.
